summary: {architect} attaches photographs to an independent finding about a county repair.
realLife: Merced agreed to pay for an independent licensed architect whose certifications would document corrected barriers with photographs.
gates: A repair subject to independent certification is ready for inspection.
inGame: needs: the work order, inspection photographs and independent finding.

turns.what: The architect signs the finding with photographs.
turns.pulledBy: The installed work meets the applicable standard.
turns.writesBack: The repair file gains an independent certification.

turns.what: The architect documents the remaining barrier.
turns.pulledBy: The installation differs from the drawing.
turns.writesBack: The work order returns to the installer.
